name: Lluçà (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the light blue castle of the arms.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council on 2 August 2002 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3744 of 21 October 2002; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with the light blue castle of the arms 3/4 of the height and 13/36 of the length at the centre.

features.role: castle of the arms, 3/4 of the height
